mcqs.question: Who was identified as the INTACH expert associated with Erra Matti Dibbalu?
mcqs.explanation: D. Rajasekhar Reddy was identified as the INTACH expert associated with Erra Matti Dibbalu. Alok Rath and P. Thimma Reddy were associated with the study of archaeological finds, while Nara Lokesh was associated with the 360° GCC Advisory Council.
